fact: A client who feels wronged may complain to the Commission bancaire and obtain mediation through the OQSF, the observatory created by decree 2020-291 and made operational in October 2024, per Fraternite.

The Observatory for the Quality of Financial Services (OQSF), created by decree in 2020, presented an online portal on 29 July 2025 to receive and handle complaints from financial-sector clients, including e-money issuers' customers, with a mediation role.
